notes.title: Now with achievements!
notes.notes:
Is the allure of putting on a Luchador mask and solving an entire city's problems via conversation or brawling not quite enough for you?

If you are that specific type of person, you now have the extrinsic motivation of 33 achievements to motivate you! Go get 'em, tiger!
